title: Select hosted metadata files
responsibility: Select committed text metadata paths for bundled reads.

inputs.name: hubMetadataPaths.entries
inputs.description: An array of source entries, each with a type, mode, and repository path. Only blob entries with mode `100644` or `100755` whose path matches a supported unit or source-metadata pattern are selected.

outputs.name: hubMetadataPaths
outputs.description: Returns the repository paths from qualifying entries, preserving input order. Paths are limited to root-level unit JSON files under `specification/units/` and `plan.json` or JSON/Markdown files under `designs/` within one directory below `src/{pages,shells,layouts,components,functions,configs,services}/`; the result contains paths, not file contents.
